slice: S4-R — correction to S4 forms integration (touched focus-loss + async provenance)
authorization: Lead S4-R directive at b4444e4 (S4 CONDITIONALLY ACCEPTED): correct two defects in ONE bounded commit. S4-F01 (Medium): touched tied to selection instead of focus loss — track focus leaving the ENTIRE control (shadow DOM + popup aware), call onTouched ONCE at the focus-loss boundary, do NOT touch merely because onChange ran; internal focus moves must not prematurely touch. S4-F02 (Medium): gesture-based provenance cannot distinguish delayed programmatic changes — deterministic coverage of a writeValue-started server fetch completing after a user gesture; conservative rule that NEVER echoes known programmatic completions into forms; document limitation if exact provenance is not establishable. Must not duplicate core selection authority. No core changes, no new event payloads, no package restructuring, no dependency upgrades, no SSR remediation.

S4-F01.title: Touched state tied to selection changes, not focus loss
S4-F01.symptom: markTouched() fired onTouched inside handleChangeForValueAccessor on every user selection; selection without leaving focus marked touched early, focus-and-leave without selecting did not touch, internal moves were indistinguishable from real leaves.
S4-F01.fix: Focus-in/out tracking on the component host; onTouched fires once only when focus truly leaves the whole control (relatedTarget/activeElement not within the control's composed shadow subtree); one-shot per focus session.

S4-F02.title: Gesture-based provenance cannot distinguish delayed programmatic changes
S4-F02.symptom: writeValue-started serverSide.fetchSelectedItems is async; the programmatic window closed before the fetch resolved; a user gesture armed in the await gap caused the late programmatic completion change to be classified as a user edit and echoed into the form model.
S4-F02.fix: Conservative in-flight programmatic-application counter: incremented before setSelectedValues, decremented on settle; any change observed while > 0 is programmatic and never echoed. Sync changes caught by the programmatic origin branch.

touchedSemantics.boundary: focus-loss of the whole control (host focusin/focusout)
touchedSemantics.listeners: focusin + focusout on component host (bubbling, composed -> cross shadow boundary)
touchedSemantics.internalMoveDetection: relatedTarget within host composed subtree (host.contains + shadow-chain walk); activeElement fallback when relatedTarget is null

asyncProvenance.decrementedOn: promise settle (resolve or reject), exactly once
asyncProvenance.syncPath: change emitted inside call -> branch (B) origin==='programmatic' (before counter increment window)
asyncProvenance.asyncPath: completion change arrives while counter > 0 -> branch (A) treated as programmatic
asyncProvenance.disclosedLimitation: A genuine user edit made WHILE a server-backed programmatic selection fetch is in flight is conservatively treated as programmatic and NOT reported to the form model. Safer trade-off (never a false echo) pending core exposing its private SelectionReason (out of scope).

onChangeRule: unchanged from S4: only genuine user edits (provenance-classified), exactly once; branch (A)/(B) are structural no-ops for the form model

selectionAuthority.note: S4-R adds no selection logic; only classification of when to report/touch. Core owns selection.

s3BoundaryPreserved.classificationLocation: inside existing change listener before stopPropagation/emit (unchanged)

s4f01: focus enter+leave with NO value change marks touched
internal move (relatedTarget inside host) does NOT touch
one-shot guard: two focusouts in one session -> one touch; re-focus re-arms
s4f02: writeValue(['b','c']) async fetch + keydown 'a' arm during flight + fetch resolve -> changes === [] (completion not echoed)
regressionTests.cvaSpecRewritten: control-value-accessor.spec.ts touched test now asserts selection alone does NOT touch and focus-loss touches once (old expectation was the S4-F01 defect)
